heroHeadline: Trump Tells Fox News 'We Shouldn't Have Been in Iran'; IRGC Threatens to Suspend Talks; Bond Market Sends Inflation Warning — Day 498
heroSubtitle: On June 1, 2026 (Day 498 of Trump's second term / Day 93 of the US-Iran war), Trump made a stunning admission in a Fox News interview with Lara Trump: 'We shouldn't have been there in the first place... We shouldn't have been in Iran.' The statement reverses prior justifications for the February 28 war. Trump simultaneously claimed the US 'left Iran's military alone' and described Iran's military as 'somewhat moderate' — while asserting B-2 bomber strikes prevented Iran from getting a nuclear weapon. US forces struck Iranian radar, drone sites, and Qeshm island over the preceding weekend; Iran retaliated against a US base in Kuwait. Iran's Revolutionary Guard-linked media announced Iran was considering suspending indirect talks with the US and threatened to open 'other fronts,' specifically the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. Bond markets sent a new inflation warning to Trump as the Iran war energy spike drove Treasury yields higher — analysts (Penn Wharton's Kent Smetters) attributed 40% of the rise to Iran war/tariff inflation and 60% to deficit expectations. Trump posted on Truth Social that Iran 'really wants to make a deal.' No signed agreement exists; the May 29 ceasefire framework remains unsigned.
